full_definition: Current repository including canonical Core contracts plus Thread, Retrieval, Dependency Ripple, Source Anomaly, Half-Life, public/read-side projections and retained operational/product-era surfaces.

observed_integration_state.interpretation: The broader repository contains these canonical contracts, but existing higher-level projections do not automatically compose them into additional behavior.

cases.reason: There is no concrete model observation to project. Additional presentation/retrieval machinery does not improve the legal answer.
Core lacks a narrow incorporation/reference owner and Full has no existing projection that repairs that gap without new adapter/schema work.

The judicial positive-validity gap remains. Current Thread/Retrieval source-kind vocabularies do not consume Judicial Holding directly, so broader surfaces cannot rescue the missing canonical representation.
Core Temporal already answers the repeated date/scope query deterministically. Wrapping it in Thread/Retrieval would add setup without changing the answer.
Core language-scoped mutation already preserves the historical correction state. Existing read-side projections do not directly consume that contract as a first-class source kind.

full_summary.important_interpretation: This does not require deleting historical projections. It removes their presumption of centrality. They must earn future use case by case.
